title: AMRC Antarctica Simulation
description: The AMRC (Antarctic Meteorological Research Center) Antarctica Simulation is a web-based 3-D interactive visualization of automated weather stations in Antarctica.
This project features several dozen stations with custom instrument configurations that are representative of the real stations.
Terrain from across the entire continent of Antarctica is included in the surroundings for each station.
This visualization has been used in classes at Madison College along with several outreach events at SSEC.
